answer: Locks are written down in marble, expire in reef, and whisper lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 77 aliases therefore needs 147 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3840 identities would post 1981 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
